# Feature Readiness Checklist: Snapshot Domain & Immutable Dataset Publishing

**Purpose**: Validate specification and plan requirements quality, clarity, and completeness before generating implementation tasks
**Created**: 2026-11-19
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

---

## 1. Core Lifecycle & Immutability Requirements Quality

- [x] CHK001 Are state transitions (`CREATING`, `READY`, `ARCHIVED`, `FAILED`) explicitly defined with pre-conditions and failure triggers? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Plan §Data Model]
- [x] CHK002 Is the immutability enforcement rule quantified for both internal items and external upstream modifications? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK003 Are referential guard requirements specified to prevent hard-deletion of upstream assets and annotation revisions pinned by finalized snapshots? [Coverage, Spec §FR-003, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK004 Is the asset uniqueness constraint within a single snapshot unambiguously defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]

## 2. Stratification & Annotation Resolution Requirements Quality

- [x] CHK005 Are selection policy criteria (`LATEST_APPROVED` vs `LATEST_SUBMITTED`) documented with clear inclusion rules and fallback behaviors? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK006 Does the specification explicitly define how unannotated assets are partitioned across splits? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK007 Is the multilabel iterative stratification algorithm defined with deterministic tie-breaking rules and seed support? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, Spec §FR-010, Research §1]
- [x] CHK008 Can the 2% class distribution deviation threshold across splits be objectively verified? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]

## 3. Integrity & Manifest Requirements Quality

- [x] CHK009 Is the canonical JSON serialization format for item checksum computation specified deterministically? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012, Research §2]
- [x] CHK010 Is the aggregate checksum computation rule defined as order-independent via sorted digests? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013, Research §2]
- [x] CHK011 Are manifest storage and relational descriptor requirements clearly delineated between S3 and PostgreSQL? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013, Spec §FR-014, Plan §Data Model]

## 4. Async Execution, Cancellation & Scale Requirements Quality

- [x] CHK012 Are cancellation requirements specified for in-progress `CREATING` snapshot jobs including rollback and status transitions? [Coverage, Spec §FR-002, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK013 Is the 60-minute execution timeout quantified with automatic failure transition and resource cleanup rules? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, Research §3]
- [x] CHK014 Are pagination requirements (Keyset seek via ULID, maximum 1,000 items) specified for large snapshot queries? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019, Spec §Edge Cases]

## 5. Comparison, Lifecycle & Governance Requirements Quality

- [x] CHK015 Is the two-tier response structure for Snapshot Diff (KPI summary vs paginated item deltas) explicitly specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015, Research §6]
- [x] CHK016 Are mutable release tag reassignment and uniqueness requirements defined without conflicts? [Consistency, Spec §FR-020, Spec §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK017 Are deletion guardrails (active downstream job block, soft-delete default, owner-only purge) unambiguously documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017, Spec §User Story 5]
- [x] CHK018 Are non-null positive integer user ID constraints documented consistently across all snapshot operations? [Consistency, Spec §FR-018, Constitution §II]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially (CHK001–CHK018) for easy reference
